name: Vanilla Brûlée Latte
flavor_notes: This drink features a rich espresso and oat milk base, topped with a creamy vanilla cold foam and a caramelized sugar brûlée crust.
barista_note: Whip the cold foam first so it forms a stable, airy head before pouring espresso over ice.

preparations.roast_note: Balanced profile with caramel and toasted nut notes suited for flavored milks and syrups.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Big Trouble or Joe Coffee The Daily

ingredients.notes: For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: ## Phase 1: Cold Foam Preparation
In a small frothing cup, combine the cold foam ingredients and froth with a handheld milk frother for 20–30 seconds until thick and airy. Set aside.
## Phase 2: Glass Staging & Ice Base
Fill your serving glass with ice cubes, then pour in cold milk.
## Phase 3: Coffee Extraction & Pour
Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour the melted coffee directly over the iced milk.
## Phase 4: Crown & Garnish
Spoon the prepared cold foam from Phase 1 over the top of the iced latte.
Finish with a dusting of sugar.

steps: ## Phase 1: Cold Foam Preparation
In a small frothing cup, combine the cold foam ingredients and froth with a handheld milk frother for 20–30 seconds until thick and airy. Set aside.
## Phase 2: Glass Staging & Ice Base
Fill your serving glass with ice cubes, then pour in cold milk.
## Phase 3: Coffee Extraction & Pour
Dissolve 2 tsp instant espresso in 2 oz (60 ml) hot water to fully bloom the coffee, then pour directly over the iced milk.
## Phase 4: Crown & Garnish
Spoon the prepared cold foam from Phase 1 over the top of the iced latte.
Finish with a dusting of sugar.
